registry.counterDomain: SessionRef (originInstanceId, sessionId, incarnation); writerEpoch is a separate fencing axis, never a counter reset
allocatingCommits: each changed process/native binding/source log-reference set
each accepted new lifecycle fact including denial/tombstone fact
nonAllocatingCalls: route coordinator or A copy/action commit
byte-identical retry or duplicate native fact
registry.atomicity: one origin state change + exactly one lifecycle event + revision + outbox commit; native-binding/log-reference updates use admitted with current admissionRef, without reverting terminal state
registry.lifecycle: firstRevision = events[0].originRevision; each next event is previous+1; every event has batch sessionRef and writerEpoch; at A accept a fully identical replay or next contiguous suffix, quarantine conflicting coordinates, refuse a hole
registry.listing: body.originRevision = projection.originRevision = current committed origin revision; projection.sessionRef = authenticated origin session; full coarse projection may jump revisions, never reveals detailed events
registry.snapshot: body sessionRef/writerEpoch/originRevision = nested descriptor; snapshot facts and tombstone/denial floors cannot roll back; a higher writerEpoch needs a verified durable fence and snapshot before events; unknown floor requires a new incarnation
registry.digestInput: listing = UTF8(JCS(projection)); activated = UTF8(JCS(snapshot.body)), including issuer/kid/times, excluding detached signature
registry.freshness: digest must match the exact latest authorized committed coarse payload or exact signed snapshot body already committed at A, at the same writer/revision; publish snapshot for a changed activated revision before its freshness; repeated freshness does not allocate
registry.duplicates: Retry an outbox record with its original signed bytes. Later leases/freshness may change times at the same revision without changing origin facts. Compare facts separately from renewable carrier metadata; conflicting origin facts quarantine.

sourceConsent.counterDomain: native (pairId, sourceSessionId, sourceGeneration, streamIncarnation, origin agentSessionId) fence
sourceConsent.allocate: Atomically persist the first verified journal/projection snapshot as 1; increment once per changed committed fence snapshot, including a negative state; duplicate observation does not increment.
snapshotFields: exact full Target digest and L2/source association
renewalTriggers: journal append/refusal/revocation or changed selected grant
A consentRevision change or either signed lease approaching cutoff
sourceConsent.compare: Binding, native ACK and projection ACK must carry the exact current pair (consentRevision,sourceConsentRevision), bindingDigest, Target and journal fence. No max across axes; zero/future/older source revision refuses.
sourceConsent.refetch: A re-resolves native fence before issuing a replacement; B fetches again on any trigger. GET(bindingId,consentRevision) returns the current source-revision binding for that A revision, never an immutable cache entry. Same A revision may have a later source revision; old ACK digest is invalidated atomically.
sourceConsent.leaseOnly: A shortened lease renewal with identical fence snapshot may reuse sourceConsentRevision, but must use the fresh binding digest and matching ACK before activation. It never extends the underlying journal consent.
sourceConsent.restart: Counter and invalidation floor survive restart/restore. Unknown/rolled-back journal or fence refuses; never reset within the same domain. Historical native journal payloads remain unchanged.

bind.earlyObservationPoint: A: after full Bind verification, while paused, before starting the Bound write; any extra already-decrypted buffered byte at this checkpoint closes before a handler
bind.duringBoundFence: After that checkpoint, bytes arriving while Bound write callback/drain is pending stay buffered and belong to the upcoming HTTP/2 parser; do not drain/unshift or reject ordinary coalesced preface/SETTINGS
bind.clientListenerRemoval: B removes all Bind/Bound readable/data/error/end/close listeners before http2.connect; both endpoints keep circuit-lifetime error handling and give HTTP/2 the same paused bound socket after their own write fence
bind.observationLimit: This is a local buffer observation, not a claim to infer when the peer sent bytes still in flight. Invalid post-checkpoint bytes are rejected by HTTP/2.

retention.finite: immutable firstAdmissionAt + durationMs; reject unsafe integer sum; amend/read/replay/import/reconnect cannot change it
retention.capBasis: v1 product interoperability limit: ten Julian years (10 * 365.25 * 86400000 ms), not a statutory retention obligation; unchanged from r1
retention.disabled: enabled=false authorizes no capture even if retention.kind=none

sourceCredentials.bindingTime: trusted host composition when constructing the connector, before connect; provider reference is immutable for that connector, never a JSON argument or per-call header
sourceCredentials.signature: resolve(context: { sessionRef: SessionRef; bindingRef: SessionRelayConnectParametersV1['bindingRef']; target: RC0Target | null; routeId: SessionRelayLaneRequestParametersV1['routeId'] | SessionRelayLaneStreamParametersV1['routeId']; pathParameters: SessionRelayLaneRequestParametersV1['pathParameters'] | SessionRelayLaneStreamParametersV1['pathParameters']; signal: AbortSignal }): Promise<SourceCredentialLeaseV1 | null>
sourceCredentials.leaseSignature: SourceCredentialLeaseV1 = { readonly sessionRef: SessionRef; readonly targetDigest: string | null; readonly expiresAt: number; applyTo(sink: { setSourceAuthHeader(name: string, value: string): void }): void }
sourceCredentials.sink: Only the trusted provider receives the sink; it accepts exactly the source-auth header names/encoding from the received RC0 capsule, bounded by the 8192-byte header list. Pseudoheaders, host/authority, cookie, origin and arbitrary headers refuse. Unknown capsule header pin => relay_grant_unavailable; no invented header name. applyTo is synchronous, called once immediately before send, never serialized or exposed to h2a caller/JSON. Connector brands and binds the returned lease privately to that provider and current host admission.
sourceCredentials.context: all fields copied from the authenticated current connector/host Target and validated route; target=null only for bootstrap source registration; handle is opaque, branded and operation/session/Target scoped; its bytes never enter JSON, logs or caller-visible return values
sourceCredentials.carriage: mesh asks the trusted provider immediately before RC0 source-authenticated request/stream headers; trusted host transport adapter applies the frozen RC0 source credential from the opaque handle, never an arbitrary user header
sourceCredentials.refresh: resolve for each request/stream opening and again after waits before headers; recheck scope at every stream emission. A changed full Target, connectionGeneration or local admission invalidates old handle/client and closes affected streams; fresh connect/provider resolution required.
sourceCredentials.absent: missing provider/null lease => lane error relay_auth_required; stale Target/connection => relay_stale_generation; foreign session => relay_scope_refused; expired lease => relay_grant_expired; provider/apply failure => relay_grant_unavailable. These local relay errors occur before body/handoff. Only an actual matched RC0 endpoint response becomes endpointRefusal (including source_auth_required); never synthesize response bytes.
sourceCredentials.ownership: h2a native host owns credential custody for CLI; cluster-mesh owns installation/workload signers and route/TLS bytes. Additive mesh routes never call this provider or gain authority from a source handle.

runtimeComposition.connected: connected result is the existing JSON connected projection plus non-serializable client. clientRef is diagnostic only; deserializing JSON never instantiates a client. A refused result has no client.
runtimeComposition.failures: Expected validation/authentication/transport/storage failures resolve as existing typed refusal values. Only invalid JavaScript API use (non-object arguments/options, non-AbortSignal signal) throws/rejects TypeError. Provider exceptions are sanitized to relay_grant_unavailable. Aborts use relay_unavailable; no new wire error code.
runtimeComposition.stream: Cold single-consumer iterator: first next() validates and opens exactly one HTTP/2 stream. Each next() yields one complete decoded route-correlated response; no concurrent next(). Normal EOF after complete event returns done=true. Failure yields exactly one typed error/refusal value then done=true. Mid-event EOF => relay_protocol_refused, never a partial record. Incompatible route => typed relay_lane_refused. Buffered event queue <=8 and <=131072 encoded bytes; overflow => relay_backpressure and close stream.
runtimeComposition.termination: iterator.return() cancels only its request, releases pending waits/listeners and resolves done=true; abort while next() waits yields one relay_unavailable then ends. client.close() idempotently fences all its lanes, resolves pending finite requests with relay_unavailable and pending stream next() with one error then end. Natural EOF/close conveys no action outcome.
runtimeComposition.concurrency: one action stream per source generation; claims may run alongside it in actions. Single stream consumer, no source-stream fan-out; all operations recheck current authority after waits and before delivery/commit.
runtimeComposition.localPorts: origin methods use one parameter object exactly matching their schemas (not the illustrative r1 positional notation). Ingest duplicates reuse committed coordinates/outbox; publishListing/snapshot/renewFreshness do not allocate originRevision.

httpProfile.success: 200 unless explicit route override; upgrade 101, listing create 201, listing delete 204
httpProfile.json: Send application/json; receive application/json optionally followed by a single charset=utf-8 parameter (ASCII case-insensitive, optional surrounding whitespace). Reject other media types/parameters/encodings before body allocation; identity content-encoding only. Strict bounded UTF-8 JSON, no duplicate/unknown keys. Bodyless routes have zero entity bytes; list query is not a GET body. JSON error bodies follow the route refusal family.

sse.heartbeatAuthority: comment only; no id/event/data, no freshness or cursor advancement; auth rechecked before any emission
sse.terminalError:
after headers, event: error
data: <JCS(RemoteSessionViewErrorV1)>

, without id, then close; do not change HTTP status or advance resume position
sse.inner: RC0 source-control/action SSE retains frozen RC0 framing; r2 does not rewrite that wire

listQuery.encoding: ?limit=<canonical decimal 1..64>[&after=<22-character canonical base64url cursorId>]; decode once, either key order accepted; no duplicate/unknown keys, plus, malformed percent escape or bearer
listQuery.authorization: current cookie/grant before cursor lookup; after absent => null; empty after refuses

identityTarget.status: TARGET fields frozen locally; canonical-byte and signed positives BLOCKED_EXTERNAL on DEP-AUTH-B/M0
identityTarget.note: RegistryReaderV1.schema.json describes local invocation data, not serialized functions. No additional signature is invented for H2/H3.
